units.source_text: 深秋有一天黄昏，朔风乍起，顿感寒气侵肤。

en.t: One evening in late autumn, a north wind suddenly rose, and the chill seemed to pierce the skin.

units.source_text: 皇上追思往事，倍觉伤心，便派韧负[\[9\]](#part1330.html#m9)命妇[\[10\]](#part1330.html#m10)赴外家存问。

en.t: The emperor thought back on the past and felt all the more grief-stricken, so he sent the Myobu of Yugei to visit her family home and ask after them.

units.source_text: 命妇于月色当空之夜登车前往。

en.t: On a night when the moon shone high in the sky, the Myobu got into her carriage and set out.

units.source_text: 皇上则徘徊望月，缅怀前尘：

en.t: The emperor, meanwhile, paced about gazing at the moon and recalling days gone by:

units.source_text: 往日每逢花晨月夕，必有丝竹管弦之兴。

en.t: In former days, whenever there were mornings of blossoms or evenings of moonlight, there was always delight in music of strings and flutes.

units.source_text: 那时这更衣有时弹琴，清脆之音，沁人肺腑；

en.t: At such times, this lady of the wardrobe would sometimes play the koto, and its clear tones would sink deep into the heart;

units.source_text: 有时吟诗，婉转悠扬，迥非凡响。

en.t: at other times she would recite poetry, her voice graceful and lingering, far beyond any ordinary sound.

units.source_text: 她的声音笑貌，现在成了幻影，

en.t: Her voice, her smile, and her face had now become only a vision,

units.source_text: 时时依稀仿佛地出现在眼前。

en.t: appearing before his eyes from time to time, faint and dreamlike.

units.source_text: 然而幻影即使浓重，也抵不过一瞬间的现实呀！

en.t: Yet no matter how vivid a vision may be, it cannot withstand even a single instant of reality.
